\begin{example} \end{example}[Euclidean segments]

Source: petersen:page-0195 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-distance-function-segments 1. ch5:5.3.3In $\mathbb R^n$, constant-speed straight segments $t\mapsto p+tv$ are segments, by section 3 applied to $r(x)=v\cdot x$ for a unit vector $v$. Each pair of points is joined by a segment unique up to reparametrization. \end{example}
